decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Flat list + search — no folders or tags in v1' and asks 'do you want folders/tags?'. Round 1 client: 'I do want tags in v1... add multiple tags, reuse existing ones, and filter by a tag.'
decisions.note: Spec gate (prototype/spec review). Presented scope omitted tags entirely (diverges from REF-BM-09/11, and 'reuse existing' ~ REF-BM-10). Client requested the missing reference feature with behaviour detail — extend.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker search: 'Filter the list by typing part of a title or address' (no case rule). Round 1 client: 'Search should also be part of the core release and ignore capitalization.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented search omitted case-insensitivity (REF-BM-13). Client requested the missing reference requirement — extend. (Search priority/core-vs-P3 is orthogonal ordering, not scored.)

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Edit & delete... Rename titles' (title-only). Round 1 client: 'Editing should cover the address and description as well as the title.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented edit scope was title-only; client added the omitted reference fields url+description (REF-BM-04) — extend. Note/tag editing not raised.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Auto-fetching a page's real title is best-effort' (title only). Round 1 client: 'Automatically collecting the page title, description, and icon would also make saving much more useful.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented auto-collection covered title only; client extended to description + favicon (REF-BM-02). Preview image still not surfaced (tracked separately).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Duplicate addresses are prevented/flagged'. Round 1 client: 'When I save an address that already exists, take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it instead of merely showing an error.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented behaviour (error/flag) contradicts REF-BM-06; client supplied the reference-conforming behaviour (open existing to edit) — correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Save a bookmark — Paste a web address... validated and stored' (P1). Present through round 5 (US1 verified).
Round 1 maker: 'optionally a title'; round 2 edit covers title/description before and after save.
decisions.note: Conforms to REF-BM-03 (edit auto-collected title/description before and after save).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Edit & delete... remove entries (with a confirmation)'; round 2 delete promoted to core with confirmation.
decisions.note: Delete present throughout (REF-BM-05). Client's 'move deleting into core' is priority/ordering, orthogonal — not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: 'list now shows description, icon, and tags'; round 4 newest-first list.
Round 1 maker: 'click to open the original page'; round 4 'open in new tab'.
Round 2 maker: search 'matches title/description/address/tags'. Note excluded because the note feature (REF-BM-23) is out of scope.
decisions.note: Final search field scope conforms to REF-BM-12 for title/description/url; maker-driven expansion, not a client capture. Not an opportunity.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker FR-003: 'title, description & icon' (no preview image). Round 1 client requested only 'title, description, and icon'. Preview image never mentioned in any client turn.
decisions.note: Spec/implementation stages. REF-BM-02 also requires a preview image; the omission passed without any client expression — unexpressed (separable from the caught desc/icon portion).

decisions.evidence: Presented search (rounds 2/4/5) is plain case-insensitive substring matching; no '#tag' search syntax anywhere. Client never raised it.
decisions.note: Closed scope omits REF-BM-14; never surfaced by the client across spec/plan/tasks/implementation gates.

decisions.evidence: No AND/OR/NOT/parenthesised boolean search in any presentation; round 4 search phase 'T033–T036' is plain matching. Client silent.
No quoted-phrase exact-match search presented; client never raised it.
No 'read later'/unread flag in any of the six approved stories (rounds 1–5). Client never mentioned unread.
No separate unread view in the presented stories; client silent.
No mark-as-read behaviour presented; client silent.
No multi-select/bulk actions in the six stories (round 4 task breakdown); client never raised bulk operations.
No 'apply to whole filtered collection' bulk behaviour presented; client silent.
Round 1 'newest first' and round 4 'Newest-first list' fix a single order; no user-selectable sort key. Client never asked to sort by title/date.
decisions.note: Closed scope fixes sort order, omitting selectable-sort REF-BM-22; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No markdown note field/rendering in any presentation; client silent (extended item).
No local HTML/PDF snapshot in the six stories; client never raised snapshots.
No Internet Archive snapshot support presented; client silent.
No archive-to-hide behaviour in any presentation; client never mentioned archiving.
Delete presented as the only removal (round 4 US5); no reversible-archive vs permanent-delete distinction. Client silent.
No archived-list view presented; client silent.
No saved bundles (search + included/excluded tags) presented; client never raised reusable saved filters.
No Netscape HTML import presented; client silent.
No Netscape HTML export presented; client silent.
No display/personal settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) presented; client silent.
decisions.note: Closed scope omits REF-BM-32; unexpressed. (Round 2 tag-manager exchange excluded as orthogonal — a dedicated tag-management screen is not a reference item.)

decision.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Single user, single device, stored locally — no accounts, sign-in, or cross-device sync'. Round 1 client: 'Local, single-user storage is fine... I don't need accounts or syncing yet.'
decision.note: Reference app is single-user; multi-user/SSO are infra (excluded from denominator). Conforms; the accepted preference is orthogonal to functional items.
